meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Rechecked role-scoped manifest generator after #265: contract docs list actual private Markdown paths/content hashes without copying prompt bodies; guardrail and JSON session semantics remain unchanged. Current acceptance belongs in GitHub #251.

auth.review_note: Compared actual AuthController password, registration and OAuth redirects and MySQL writes against auth/OAuth guides; corrected users.json and customer dashboard wording without changing credentials or behavior.

commerce.review_note: Baseline mapped existing catalogue/order/tax sources to their durable module contracts. No commerce implementation or live transaction is changed; the review does not certify tax filing or untested payment receipt.

content.review_note: Compared complete renderer with actual DOM/browser output: narrow rebuilt element/attribute/URL allowlist, literal code protection, image-before-link parsing, safe Tamil/tables, bounded input and escaped fallback. Updated content contract; hostile fixtures were local only and original stored articles unchanged.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed bootstrap CLI failure behavior: nonzero bounded diagnostic instead of successful HTML; no web auth change. Deployment guide no longer describes merged JSON runtime as draft. Business MySQL and private chat file boundaries remain intact.

interface.review_note: Reviewed current implemented media deletion and safe empty dashboard behavior; removed stale draft/unmerged claims in operator/module guides. Admin Help UI remains separately scoped to #261.

mail.review_note: Baseline checked against native SMTP claim/acceptance boundaries and current mail guide; SMTP acceptance is explicitly not inbox receipt. No mail implementation changed in this issue.

media.review_note: Compared existing guarded deletion implementation with its durable test procedure; migrated dated execution/status evidence out of docs. No customer media mutation performed.

workflow.review_note: Verified developer gh versus plain-Git hosting, issue/comment-only task records, moved historical ledgers before deleting them, explicit source/reference review receipts, and actual nonzero CLI exception behavior from #265. Index updates cannot approve prose truth.
